title: Timeline: sun points before a clock point in winter and after it in summer, a clamp, and a stepped clock
description: Munich (48.137 N, 11.576 E), Europe/Berlin. The plan: sunset on, 21:00 off, dusk + 10 min night but not after 22:00. On 2027-01-13 the device computes sunset 2027-01-13T16:44:18 and dusk 2027-01-13T17:19:43 (hc::sun_times, elevation 0): the points apply in the order of their moments, on, night (dusk + 10 min), off at 21:00, and the evening ends off. Booted at 12:00 the rule finds no point of today up to now and takes yesterday's last, 21:00 off. At 22:00 the wall clock steps to 2027-07-14 12:00 CEST (a jump): the due state is that of 2027-07-13's last point, night (dusk + 10 min clamped to 22:00), entered by a transition. On 2027-07-14 sunset is 2027-07-14T21:10:38 and dusk 2027-07-14T21:50:10: off at 21:00 comes first, then on at sunset, then night at 22:00 (dusk + 10 min would be 2027-07-14T22:00:10, the clamp moves it to 22:00); the summer evening ends in night.
note: Decided 17: the points of a day apply in the order of their actual moments; a sun point is the event of its date plus the offset, clamped (spec/rules.md 7.13). The sun times come from the device's astronomy (spec/fixtures/rules/README.md "location"); the one nearest to a rounding boundary (2027-01-14's sunset, in the check) lies 0.026 s from it, far beyond what the two implementations' libraries may differ (about 1e-9 s).
